traps: each file directly under tests/ is its own test crate: api and cli are two targets, auto-discovered, with no [[test]] section
tests/util/mod.rs is not a target: it lives in a subdirectory, and both test crates include it with mod util;
util is compiled twice, once inside each test crate: util::sample in api and in cli are two distinct items, and a symbol index that keys by file merges them
the test crates reach the library as an external crate (tally::words), not through crate::
no dependency at all: the lock has only the package itself
